definitions.authorization: user proposed zero-new-backbone representation diagnostic with matched small readout; fitting probes allowed, full-model training not authorized
hypotheses: S+ GT windows hold elevated absolute support
video-wide time support distinguishes original S+/S-
seen to pseudo contrast locates readout accessibility vs representation limits

representations.early: t2v_encoder output valid video tokens after global prefix, before temporal encoder
representations.memory: transformer memory_local valid time tokens before decoder
representations.video: input_vid_proj valid tokens; pure visual+TEF control
representations.text: input_txt_proj valid text tokens pooled mean; pure text control
representations.decoder: hs[-1] pooled exactly as original exist_head

definitions.capacity: six probes per family, each affine256+1=257 parameters, no hidden layers; standardization train-only

probe_fits.early_global: linear logistic on full-video mean early, original video existence labels only
probe_fits.memory_global: linear logistic on full-video mean memory, original existence labels only
probe_fits.decoder_global: same linear logistic on original existence pooled decoder states
probe_fits.text_global: same linear logistic on projected text mean
probe_fits.video_global: same linear logistic on projected input video mean
probe_fits.memory_window: same linear logistic; S+ train summary mean over original GT-covered positions, S- full-video mean; GT outside S+ never negative; separately marks additional temporal supervision

definitions.fit: sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1,penalty=l2,class_weight=balanced,solver=lbfgs,max_iter=1000,tol=1e-6,random_state=3407), all original train rows, no grid, no seen/pseudo/U fitting or model selection
definitions.readout: a_t=w*z(h_t)+b no time softmax; both mean and max_t as fixed pooled diagnostics. Train global probe on mean, compare mean/max without picking best. Window probe uses train GT summary only; inference max/mean does not use GT
definitions.GT_positions: centers (t+.5)*native clip_length in any original GT interval; if no centers but bin overlaps a positive GT, deterministic overlapping clips fallback. No center/overlap => unavailable window probe row and reported; inference never sees GT
definitions.metrics: video existence global weighted AUROC; S+ in-window-max vs all original S- full-video-max AUROC; per-S+ peak-in-GT and percentile rank of GT support relative to own sequence; no outside-window absence labels. native saliency untrained(weight0) auxiliary; original exist/raw/gated unchanged
definitions.comparison: same affine capacity; memory_global vs original existence uses same video labels and target; memory_window gain is supervised accessibility, not proof original head faulty. Readout failure is capacity/optimization-limited, not proof information absent
definitions.bootstrap: shared original-video union across six eval groups/canonical;1000 seed3407, exploratory95% and paired probe-original AUROC deltas. No candidate training success or confirmation
definitions.controls: same-query canonical text feature+mask from lexicographic qid as prior CONTROLLED_QUERY; exact same text input, new frozen forward; do not index-join decoder slot scores to saved windows; pure text scores must tie within each controlled group
definitions.restrictions: original model eval, requires_grad false,inference_mode; original parameter updates0; probe parameter fits separately counted; no resume training, no teacher/window, no new data/absence, no officialU/test, no changed threshold/gate/checkpoint
